items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I used to play with him sometimes too, you know. With who? With a different band.

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to play with that. You know what I'm talking about? Eddie Dorsey? Yeah, he used to play with bass player. I used to play with him sometimes too, you know. With who? With a different band. Long Tall Dock.
